newsitem.title: FRANCE: AGF in 4 bln FFr convertible issue.
newsitem.headline: AGF in 4 bln FFr convertible issue.

text.p: French insurer AGF Assurances said on Tuesday it issued four billion francs in subordinated convertible bonds as part of a debt restructuring.
The amount of convertible bonds issued could be raised to 4.4 billion francs, it said in a statement.

"This operation is part of the debt restructuring...of which a large part was short term. It will permit the lengthening of the maturity of the debt to take advantage of current interest rate market conditions. It is also aimed at strengthening the balance sheet and increasing AGF's financial manoeuvring room," it said.
